blog.definition: v. read, write, or edit a shared on-line journal
blog.translation: n. 博客；部落格；网络日志

blogged.translation: v. 维护网志（不断更新和传发他人等）( blog的过去式 )

blogger.definition: n. a person who keeps and updates a blog
blogger.translation: n. 写博客的人；博客使用者

blogs.definition:
n a shared on-line journal where people can post diary entries about their personal experiences and hobbies
v read, write, or edit a shared on-line journal
blogs.translation: n. 博客, 网志（网站上记有活动、意见等的个人记录）( blog的名词复数 )
